tasks.title: Validate task contracts and dependency graphs
tasks.acceptance: Reject invalid schemas, cycles, duplicate IDs, path escapes, and invalid budgets.
tasks.reopen: Contract or parser changes

tasks.title: Bind bounded verification to source evidence
tasks.acceptance: Retain passing and failing commands; reject stale artifacts, empty suites, and timeouts.
tasks.reopen: Runner, source scope, or evidence format changes

tasks.title: Enforce replayable task transitions
tasks.acceptance: Prove retry idempotency, one concurrent winner, stale propagation, and corruption rejection.
tasks.reopen: Event schema, projection, or concurrency mechanism changes

tasks.title: Expose one bounded agent command surface
tasks.acceptance: Read commands stay read-only and public commands return stable JSON success or error envelopes.
tasks.reopen: CLI contract or routing changes

tasks.title: Measure control cost and integrity
tasks.acceptance: Run reproducible workloads; distinguish collected values from unmeasured targets.
tasks.reopen: Benchmark workload, registry, or collection method changes

tasks.title: Integrate guidance, lessons, roadmap, and CI
tasks.acceptance: Verify foundation file references, lesson evidence, and integrated operating instructions.
tasks.reopen: Instructions, roadmap interpretation, CI contract, or lesson provenance changes

tasks.title: Migrate contracts and recover interrupted journals
tasks.acceptance: Preserve every old event, require an explicit source head, reject changed completed-task semantics, and recover only from an independently retained intact prefix.
tasks.reopen: First contract revision or interrupted write

tasks.title: Unify campaign and task evidence
tasks.acceptance: Convert real proof-campaign reports to the evidence contract; reject missing raw records and mismatched source or evaluator hashes.
tasks.reopen: A second research campaign is admitted

tasks.title: Retrieve scoped lessons and counterexamples
tasks.acceptance: Given a task scope, retrieve only evidence-backed applicable lessons; reject a lesson on an explicit out-of-scope case.
tasks.reopen: At least five distinct retained lessons

tasks.title: Fingerprint and compare execution environments
tasks.acceptance: Equivalent declared environments compare; incompatible compiler, runtime, backend, or hardware blocks performance comparison.
tasks.reopen: First cross-machine comparison

tasks.title: Evaluate performance with paired uncertainty
tasks.acceptance: Use alternating pairs, declared minimum effect and confidence interval; label noise and trade-offs without a combined correctness score.
tasks.reopen: A candidate claims runtime or memory improvement

tasks.title: Build held-out repair and proof task suites
tasks.acceptance: Version 100 tasks across at least ten families; keep development and final holdout partitions disjoint and freeze scoring before trials.
tasks.reopen: Instrumented agent evaluation is ready

tasks.title: Run budgeted agent usability trials
tasks.acceptance: Record 30 tasks, three independent repeats, model identity, prompt tokens, tool calls, dollars, success, and interventions; compare against the old workflow.
tasks.reopen: A model provider and explicit total spend ceiling are available

tasks.title: Reuse verified results by complete context key
tasks.acceptance: Hit only with matching source, evaluator, environment, objective, and law hashes; mutation probes force cache misses.
tasks.reopen: Repeated verification consumes more than 20 percent of campaign cost

tasks.title: Isolate candidate workers from evaluator authority
tasks.acceptance: A real unprivileged worker cannot write controller files, read signing material, or supply its own trusted verdict; resource exhaustion is contained.
tasks.reopen: Unattended candidate generation is introduced

tasks.title: Coordinate work across clones with expiring leases
tasks.acceptance: Two workers contend for one lease; exactly one acts, fencing rejects expired ownership, and restart preserves accepted results.
tasks.reopen: More than one independent clone executes tasks

tasks.title: Attest execution with independent signing
tasks.acceptance: Verifier-held keys sign source and result identities; forgery, replay under another task, and artifact mutation fail.
tasks.reopen: Evidence crosses a trust boundary

tasks.title: Enforce repository merge gates on the host
tasks.acceptance: Demonstrate rejected merge with failed required checks and separate review for law changes using actual host policy evidence.
tasks.reopen: Repository policy and authorized reviewer identities are selected

tasks.title: Generalize finite repair laws to variable suites
tasks.acceptance: Prove preservation for variable case lists, retain a valid witness, and reject deletion and regression counterexamples.
tasks.reopen: A real variable regression suite needs proof

tasks.title: Learn task priorities from observed value and cost
tasks.acceptance: Compare declared static ordering with a learned policy on held-out tasks at equal budgets; retain confidence and exploration cost.
tasks.reopen: Thirty comparable completed trials exist

tasks.title: Test whether lessons transfer without regressions
tasks.acceptance: Use paired with-lesson and without-lesson trials on disjoint task families; measure both positive and negative transfer.
tasks.reopen: Ten independently reproduced lessons exist

tasks.title: Validate Linux and macOS recovery behavior
tasks.acceptance: Run lock, timeout, child cleanup, and replay tests on both operating systems; report unsupported native Windows explicitly.
tasks.reopen: A second operating system is available in CI

tasks.title: Compact history with verified replay equivalence
tasks.acceptance: Snapshot 10000 events, replay the suffix, compare full state byte-for-byte, and reject a corrupted anchor.
tasks.reopen: Measured replay p95 exceeds 500 ms

tasks.title: Evaluate a supervisor without evaluator self-modification
tasks.acceptance: Supervisor changes only next-campaign search policy; worker cannot alter objectives or proofs; ablate supervision at equal budget.
tasks.reopen: Baseline agent trials and isolation both pass

tasks.title: Report rolling research trajectories
tasks.acceptance: Report 30-day and 90-day comparable cohorts, confidence, cost per replicated gain, regressions, and missing observations.
tasks.reopen: At least two comparable trial cohorts exist

tasks.title: Stop campaigns by measured continuation value
tasks.acceptance: Replay retained campaigns to compare fixed budgets against stopping policies; count missed improvements and saved cost.
tasks.reopen: Enough completed campaigns exist to validate stopping without reuse of holdout
